notes: Caller for the repo's %import macro (PROC IMPORT wrapper). Macro body is byte-identical except the datafile path join was changed from a literal backslash to a forward slash, since the author's join is Windows-specific and Jenner's engine runs on a POSIX filesystem -- verified by testing the unmodified backslash join, which fails with 'Input file not found' for exactly that reason (not a Jenner bug). The call exercises the macro's own documented quote-stripping (single and double quotes) and trailing-backslash-trim logic, matching the shape of the author's own example call. Input data is a 4-row inline CSV (region/visitors/year, invented placeholder figures) written to a WORK-library sandbox path in autoexec.sas, standing in for the author's real UNC network path (\\sasebi\SAS User Data\Josh Pearce\DATA).
